x: Pat Newell had been moving through nicely to the medal positions until his hamstring went at the end of the second lap and this cost our M60's a team bronze. Frank Gander was a revelation over the tough course and at the end looked as though he could go round a couple more times.
A sprightly 3 hours 35 clocking came from 65 year-old Frank Gander while Jon Ridgeon, an international hurdler only a few seasons ago, finished well inside 4 hours.

Bronze medals were won by this fine body of men, Belgrave's M60 team in the Surrey Veterans' Cross Country Championship on October 4th at Petersham, Richmond Park. Left to right: Frank Gander, Tony Stone, Gerald Collins, Derek Crookes, Dave Davies, Alan Lane and Charlie Henn.
